notes.title: Update 1.2: Model Importer
notes.content:
Golf Around now has an importer for custom 3D models! You can import your own or get models from others on the Workshop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/4ce9d3baa2f46d1f7cabbffb6e25e0500893dad8.png[/img]

Read the full Importer guide here:
[url=https://www.golfaroundgame.com/importer]https://www.golfaroundgame.com/importer[/url]

The model format is .OBJ only, with optional .MTL files for materials. (You can export this format from Blender easily.) Animations are not supported, sorry.
Each asset is a unique workshop item, which you can make private or public.
Assets are also fully embedded in the map files, so they won't break if the assets aren't present.

If you need any help using it, join our Discord here and ask for help: [url=https://discord.gg/h6vzVq5]https://discord.gg/h6vzVq5[/url] 

[b]Keep in mind this is a new tool and will probably need some fixes. If you find a bug it's very helpful to report it on Discord or the forums![/b]

notes.title: Vaporwave Update + Sale! [0.6.0]
notes.content:
As a special promotion, the game is on sale for TWO WEEKS!

Ever wanted to golf in a highly aesthetic 80s atmosphere? Now you can. Vaporwave is the most difficult map yet. Watch out for the katanas.

Vaporwave has also been added to the editor, with all basic props and 40+ unique props. It has a new par achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/ab2bf98451e73269c29954a5d9bb340a9fa4b412.png[/img]

The editor now has custom text where you can type your own message, under Special. There's a new group of settings where you can pick a base terrain, skybox, and music. (Not a terrain editor, but you can pick the main texture.) The editor is now at 774 objects including texture variants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/eeae344646e4c23dc3cfdad435b9333631b1dde1.png[/img]

notes.title: Golf Around! is released!
notes.content:
Golf Around is now out! It will be available for -34% off for the next week! If you'd like to join our Discord here is the link: https://discord.gg/h6vzVq5

Golf Around! is a multiplayer Mini Golf game with crazy golf courses. In addition, you can easily play and create custom levels!
New content is continually being developed.

Features:
[list]
[*] Online multiplayer and single player
[*] A level creator with many community maps
[*] 4 built in courses: Village, Dungeon, Snowy and Lab
[*] A wide variety of game options and modes
[*] Steam Items to customize your ball
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Much more to come!
[/list]
